posts.title: A Poem, for my Love
posts.description: Oh Muse, holder of the key to my heart, keystone of the base of my gentle soul, you who set the hearth-fire of my passion ablaze, as the curtain of the heavens, when it is pulled back, to reveal the stars in their glorious multitude shining brightly in the darkness of the black night, so fiercely does my love shine for my own Aurora, bringer of the bright new day.
